# Fonts shipped with Prop Desk

Self-hosted so the theme works offline. No game fonts and no Bethesda files.

| File | Family | License |
|---|---|---|
| `ShareTechMono-Regular.woff2` | Share Tech Mono | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL-ShareTechMono.txt`). Copyright 2012, Carrois Type Design. |
| `RobotoCondensed-Regular.woff2`, `RobotoCondensed-Bold.woff2` | Roboto Condensed | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL-RobotoCondensed.txt`). Copyright 2011 The Roboto Project Authors. |
| `CourierPrime-Regular.ttf` | Courier Prime | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL-CourierPrime.txt`). Headings in the Pip-Boy theme only. |
| `StardosStencil-Regular.ttf` | Stardos Stencil | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL-StardosStencil.txt`). Headings in the Vault theme only. |
| `Rye-Regular.ttf` | Rye | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL-Rye.txt`). Headings in the Wasteland themes only. |

If a file fails to load, the app falls back to the phone's own monospace and sans-serif fonts.
